Super capacitors are used in parallel combination in the hybrid system to increases battery performance, efficiency and life of battery this system can play important role in betterment of transportation as well as in enhancing electrification of transportation. Nanostructure materials in batteries ameliorate the electrochemical performances of existing electrode materials for lithium-ion batteries, for this purpose nanotechnology based hybrid system is very beneficial.

articleTitle: An efficient approach for the detection of White Matter, Gray Matter, and cerebrospinal fluid from MR images of the brain using an advanced multilevel thresholding
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Brain Tissue segmentation is essential in surgical planning and in diagnosing neurological diseases. This paper enlightened a novel and automatic approach for the segmentation of White Matter, Gray Matter, and CSF tissues from the MR Images of the brain. This Multilevel Segmentation of MR Images of the brain uses the concept of Harmony Search Optimization (HSO). In comparison with the other evolutionary approaches, HSO exhibits low computational complexity with interesting search capabilities. The algorithm uses the objective functions proposed by Otsu or Kapur to guide the candidate solutions, derived from an appropriate search space inside the image histogram. The operators of HSO evolve the candidate solutions until the best threshold value is found. The pursuance of the suggested method is evaluated in terms of sensitivity, specificity, segmentation accuracy using ground truth images and the results are compared with some of the existing methods. The results proved the effectiveness of the proposed approach for the MR brain image segmentation.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of standalone photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: The Electricity requirement of the world including India is increasing at an alarming rate. Several recent energy crises has forced the world to develop new and alternate method for production of electricity, since we so for not adopted due to various reason. Thus use of renewable energy is quite important. The performance analysis of a solar photo voltaic power plant is very important due to environment and economic benefits. Increase in the usage of standalone photovoltaic (SAPV) systems forces the better and even deeper understanding of factors that influence the performance of SAPV systems for better efficiency. Many researchers have analyzed the PV module in terms of panel modelling and I–V characteristics but in this works aspects that involve external conditions are not taken into consideration.This paper analyses performance consideration and factors that affect the performance of the SAPV such as effect of dust and shadowing. This paper also shows how these factors can lead to reduction in power output of Standalone Photovoltaic and cause a permanent degradation of PV cell.

articleTitle: A statistical study on the AC breakdown voltage of corn oil and mineral oil for liquid insulation
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: In recent years, insulation designers have been emphasized many researches on natural ester oils to replace mineral oil because of its high biodegradability, better dielectric characteristics, more resource of availability and etc. This work aims to investigate the corn oil (CO) as alternate liquid insulation to mineral oil (MO). In order to ensure the ability of natural ester as potential replacement for liquid insulation, statistical analysis of AC breakdown strength is conducted apart from measuring the other oil properties such as density, viscosity, flash point, fire point, color, moisture content and acidity. Statistical analysis of breakdown voltage on corn oil is carried out with two parametric distributions (Normal and Weibull distribution). The probability of failure with respect to the breakdown voltage on corn oil and at risk levels of 1%, 5%, 10%, 25% and 50% probability are estimated to ensure the withstand capacity of corn oil under various stress conditions. For reference purpose, mineral oil is also investigated in this work. From the statistical investigation result, it is found that the corn oil has the suitable and better breakdown characteristics than the mineral oil. Hence the corn oil has the potential to replace traditional mineral oil in high voltage transformer.

articleTitle: Design of 4 bit 4 pulse finite state machine serial adder
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: There are many ways of modeling the behavior of systems, and the use of state machines is one of the oldest and best known. The behavior of the system at a given point in time depends upon the current state and the input or events that occur at that time. For each state the system may be in, behavior is defined for each possible input or event. Here we design a FSM serial adder in SIMULINK.

articleTitle: VHDL based BLOWFISH implementation for secured Embedded System design
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Embedded devices are becoming more popular and used in network communications. These devices are now used commonly for storing data and exchange of data through public networks. Wireless networking imposes threat to the sensitive data. To protect sensitive data against threat embedded devices are designed with inbuilt security features. The sensitive data is encrypted before transmission so that only authorized user can have access to such information. Hardware implementation of encryption algorithm is helpful in designing secured Embedded System. VHDL based Blowfish algorithm implementation and analysis is discussed in this paper. The algorithm is implemented with different keys and timing required for encryption, decryption are presented.

articleTitle: Neural network based cycloconverter fault detection using wavelet decomposition
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Power electronic devices may fail to function normally due to unexpected breakdown of various power electronic component. This fact motivates to find an effective but simple technique for real time diagnosis of component failure in cycloconverter, which is commonly used in industry to vary the speed of an <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">AC motor</sub> by means of controlling its frequency. Wavelet decomposition method is employed for detecting faulty component path by extracting the substantial signatures from the output waveforms across the load end of cycloconverter. Backpropagation multilayer perceptron(BPMLP) based artificial neural network(ANN) and probabilistic neural network(PNN) are used to correctly distinguish the faulty path including two power MOSFET in the cycloconverter. Results indicate high classification accuracy at most of 99.9%. The proposed method will also minimize the fault removal time and hence maintain the production consistency in the industry.

articleTitle: Comparison of ultra-capacitor and hybrid ultra-capacitor
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: The industries all over the world are increasing manifold and efforts are being made to generate energy using renewable sources to compensate for depleting fossil fuels. The large energy being generated using various non-conventional sources need to be stored for a long period for its efficient use. An ultracapacitor (UC) is a high-capacity electrochemical capacitor whose capacitance values are much higher than other usual capacitors. Hybrid ultracapacitor (HUC) uses electrodes with differing characteristics: one exhibiting mostly electrostatic capacitance and the other mostly electrochemical capacitance. In this project, we emphasize upon comparing the characteristics of UC and HUC and deciding the suitability of these in various industrial applications. Also, the concept of flash charging, which is recently gaining momentum for charging of ultracapacitor driven short distance city buses, is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: ANN based ranking algorithm for products on E-Commerce website
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: ANN is a widely used technology in computing world and there are number of areas where it is applicable. E-Commerce sector is also a kind of an area where ANN based algorithms can be applied. Quality of product is very essential thing for the customer as well as stakeholders of the company. Customer of an E-Commerce website has no way to assess quality of a product accept to read huge number of reviews. This research work focus over developing a decision making algorithm which can evaluate quality of a product by categorizing previous reviews on a scale of numbers and display it over an E-commerce website. Customers can make use of this ranks provided with products over any E-Commerce website to make their own decisions.

articleTitle: Certificate-free collaborative key agreement based on IKEv2 for IoT
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: End to end security in IoT is becoming a challenging issue in the upcoming smart world. Providing security in a heterogeneous environment is a critical factor when the devices are resource constrained in nature. In this work, a novel certificate-less collaborative key agreement technique has been proposed for IoT, where the computationally heavy tasks are handed over to unconstrained nodes. The receiver agrees upon the secret key, based on the collaborative values from the constrained(sender) and the unconstrained node. This algorithm is a variant of IKEv2 key agreement protocol used in the current scenario. The algorithm is tested with the tool Scyther, which is a automatic security verification tool.

articleTitle: Selection of genes mediating human leukemia, using an Artificial Neural Network approach
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: In this article, we describe multilayer perceptron model for selection of some possible human leukemia genes mediating different disease. The procedure involves grouping of gene based correlation coefficient using human leukemia gene expression data sets. The usefulness of the procedure has been demonstrated human leukemia expression data sets. The superiority of the procedure has been established three existing gene selection methods like Support Vector Machine (SVM), Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and Significance Analysis of Microarray (SAM). We have performed biochemical pathway, p-value, t-test, expression profile plots for identifying biological and statistically pertinent gene sets. In this procedure, we have found more number of true positive genes then the other existing methods.

articleTitle: Comparison of different types of Raschig rings
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Transformer's life mainly depends on the quality of oil volume it contains. Regular transformer oil filtration assures long and consistent results from the transformer. High vacuum transformer oil filtration machine purifies the transformer oil. This paper aims to compare Raschig rings of different shapes and materials. Raschig rings are kept in the degassing and dehydration chamber of high vacuum transformer oil filtration machine where the gas and moisture content from the transformer oil are removed using vacuum pumping system. Usually hollow cylindrical shaped Raschig rings are used in high vacuum transformer oil filtration machine. If spherical shaped Raschig rings are used instead of hollow cylindrical Raschig rings, the whole volume surface area of the Raschig rings will be utilized for degasification. The effective surface area for the oil to get spread will increase. As a result the surface tension of the oil, spread on Raschig rings, will get reduced and evaporation of gases from the oil in the degassing chamber will be faster, thus reducing the cycle time of the oil filtration process. Raschig rings of different shapes and different materials are compared on the basis of their cost of material and shape. The comparison shows why spherical shaped Raschig rings are better to use in high vacuum transformer oil filtration machine.

articleTitle: A novel pattern classifier approach towards the performance optimization of Big Data analysis in distributed environment
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Big data is a collection of massive amount of data whose characteristics exceeds the capabilities of conventional algorithm and techniques to derive the useful value. The real power lies not just in having colossal data but in what insights can be drawn from this data to facilitate better and faster decisions. Hadoop Map Reduce is emerged as powerful and cost effective open source framework for processing large data set distributed computing environment. The load imbalance, which occurs while processing the Big Data is common problem with this framework which reduces the efficiency of the processing, may impact the QOS of the application. In this paper a new pattern classifier algorithm has been proposed to tackle these problems. The proposed algorithm integrated with the traditional environment and experimentally it has been proved that response time of Map Reduce jobs are amplified by minimizing the load imbalance factor, thereby QOS requirement of the application is achieved.

articleTitle: Electronic Sports Gloves
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Today all over the world different kinds of sports are played and most of them involve different kinds of physical activities involved. Even though there are thousands of players, there are very few who have achieved the mastery in their field. Prime reasons for this situation are lack of guidance and shortage of advance equipments. Hence, this paper introduces Electronic Sports Gloves to assist players in training which can be used in indoor as well as outdoor sports. These gloves are pre-calibrated using Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) for efficient hand movements. Yaw, pitch and roll angles of wrist actions are calculated by gyro and accelerometer, present on IMU. Gloves will recognize and compare these values with reference values so that a protégé can be guided to make those movements precisely and achieve optimum results.

articleTitle: M Energy audit report
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Energy auditing has been conducted in the Srinavasa Ramanujan Centre, SASTRA University to estimate the Energy consumed in a daily basics. Any organisation in the world that should adapt to the upcoming technology has to minimize the outcomes of power consumption. This paper explains details regarding the power consumption of various electrical devices equipped in the campus and energy consumption by those devices for a month are analyzed. Along with this energy conservation techniques are enclosed and corresponding payback time is calculated including the salvage value of the devices. Some basic ECON techniques are advised to followed by the institution which are technically and economically more feasible with least risk feasibility. Many details regarding the ECON devices are encrypted in this paper. Here finds the solution of the problem existing day today life, (i.e) ‘energy auditing’ that helps to balance the demand of day today life and used to promote the determination of electric energy supply in an efficient manner.

articleTitle: Enhancement of protective layer coated bushing under artificial coastal pollution conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Insulation performance of an electrical power system is greatly affected by the various pollution components. The level of pollution severity on the surface of insulation also determines the rate of breakdown voltage. Here, high voltage bushing is exposed to the artificial pollution conditions such as coastal pollution. This paper analyses the performance of normal bushing and silicone grease coated bushing which are polluted by the mixture NaCl and kaolin contaminants. The breakdown voltage test is carried out under both dry and wet conditions. Finally pollution breakdown voltage of normal bushing is compared with silicone grease coated bushing. The report shows that, the silicone grease coated bushing is an excellent solution to solve very severe contamination flashovers. This is due to the hydrophobic coating over the bushing.

articleTitle: Comparison of PV based Embedded Z-source inverter fed three phase induction motor with PI controller and PID controller based closed loop systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: EZSI is a good choice between PV and three phase load since PV system can be easily split into two parts. This work proposes PV based EZSI fed three phase induction motor with PI and PID controller closed loop system. PI and PID controlled systems are designed and simulated using MATLAB. The principles of operation and simulation results are discussed. The simulation results of PI and PID controlled systems are compared interims of time domain parameters and comparison table has been presented. The results indicate that the response with PID is faster than that of PI controlled system.

Author Keywords: EZSIIM-Embedded Z-Source Inverter fed Induction Motor

articleTitle: Comparative study on various single image defogging techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Fog and haze are generally a huge cause associated with accidents. Fog reduces the visibility of scene. Fog is formed by the combination of airlight and attenuation. Airlight enhances the whiteness and attenuation reduces the contrast within the scene. Fog detection and removal is a challenging task as it depends upon unknown depth information. Various fog removal methods are used for removing the fog and improving the visibility of scene. This paper gives a review on the various fog removal techniques. These techniques are used in many vision applications. It has been observed that most of the researchers have neglected many issues; i.e. no method is appropriate for different kind of circumstances. The overall objective of this paper is to find the different methods for efficiently eliminating the fog from digital images.

articleTitle: A multipath mechanism for wireless sensors network
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: When the use of wireless sensors network is becoming increasingly wider and deeper, its problems are also beginning to highlight. Due to the limit of wireless sensors' energy supply and the unstable channel, ensuring the reliability and speed of the transmission has become the research hot spot. With multipath or retransmission transmission mechanism, the redundancy of data transmission can be ensured to a certain extent, improving the reliability of the process. A new mechanism is put forward in which multipath transmission is a priority and the retransmission is a secondary consideration. While considering about the multipath transmission, a method is used to decide a best plan within a short time taking changing dynamic and comprehensive situations such as the energy consumption, the pressure of the network, the congestion condition into consideration. The next-hop nodes are chosen based on woken value which is calculated by basic value and fluctuating value. The experimental results show that the proposed mechanism can provides transmission at a faster rate, reduce the network energy consumption as well as make a balance of each node' load.

articleTitle: Inferring phylogenies from minimal information
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: In this paper we present TripNet, a method for constructing phylogenetic networks from triplets. We will present the motivations behind our approach and its theoretical and empirical justification. To demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of TripNet, we performed two simulations and also applied the method to some published data. Surprisingly, the results show that we can construct an accurate phylogenetic network using a small amount of information.

articleTitle: Optimal power flow problems solution with STATCOM using meta-heuristic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Optimal power flow is highly constrained, non linear and non convex optimization problems of the power system. This present paper introduced meta heuristic Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) algorithm to solve of OPF problems equipped with shunt connected Flexible AC transmission (FACTS) device called Static Synchronous Compensator (STATCOM). Different objective functions Fuel Cost and Voltage Deviation are considered as OPF problems. To determines the quality and effectiveness of proposed approach (GWO) applied on standard IEE-30 bus test system with and without STATCOM device. The results demonstrate that GWO algorithm given optimal setting of control varoable for all objective functions compared to other well known algorithms which were reported in literature.

articleTitle: An improved initial radius selection scheme for sphere decoding in MIMO
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Sphere decoding(SD)is an efficient algorithm which has been proposed in Multiple input Multiple output (MIMO) digital communication. Sphere decoding algorithm is based on the rule of maximum likelihood decoding algorithm, But SD algorithm does not like ML algorithm to retrieve all of the lattice. However, SD in some environment complexity is very high. The complexity of the SD is controlled by radius and play a critical role in identifying the correct point in the lattice. So, choose a fit initial radius for SD is important. In this paper, we present a new initial radius selection scheme for the SD. The scheme based on the constellation modulation type and the target bit error rate(BER) and in reducing radius at the same time to ensure that at least one point in the sphere. Through the simulation analysis, the scheme computational complexity is lower than conventional SD algorithm.

articleTitle: Summary for resonance suppression technology of renewable energy power generation
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Resonance is a common problem of power quality in the renewable energy power generation system, and its suppression strategy is closely related to the safe and stable operation of the grid connected with the renewable energy. In this paper, the generation mechanism and related influencing factors of resonance are analysed at first by analysing the specific resonance problem of photovoltaic power station and wind farm. Next, the resonance suppression measures and functions are introduced, about the photovoltaic and wind farms. From the angle of economic, simple and efficient, the three ways of resonance damping for single machine-passive damping inhibition, inhibition of active damping, a mixture of active and passive damping suppression method, and the two aspects for multi turbine active, passive damping inhibitions are compared with each other to conclude their respective advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: An approach towards effective power oscillation damping with deployment and tuning of AVR, and PSS
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: This paper discusses about the approach towards effective power oscillation damping, root causes for the genesis of power oscillation and various methodologies adopted from the very beginning to mitigate oscillations. Complexity involved with AVR and PSS in damping oscillation are investigated and to overcome this necessity of PSS tuning is simulated and verified over Eastern Region system and generator. The power oscillations, if not controlled within time, may aggravate the entire power system functioning which may lead to collapse of the entire system. Tuning of PSS is a matter of great concern as the ill tuned PSS may itself lead system towards instability which is also discussed and a guideline for tuning PSS is also suggested as deployment of tuned PSS enhances the overall system stability of the grid by shifting the eigenvalues of the states of power system towards left half. Impact of PSS over eigenvalues is also discussed. PSS/E All India dynamic base case is used for simulation of eastern region and for various case studies.

articleTitle: Optimization of energy exhaustion for Smart Camera Network in vision task
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Smart Camera Network (SCN) mainly has different applications based on the surveillance, security and safety with limited energy, power and memory. Normally cameras operate under limited power resources. To extend the lifetime of smart camera, it is required to reduce the energy consumption in an effective way. This paper mainly presents adaptive energy consumption of smart camera network, by assigning distributed and adaptive utility function for vision tasks. The switching of vision tasks between active, idle and sleep modes takes place based on the frequency and duty cycle. Switching of tasks is mainly done on the basis of availability of energy resources. Algorithm for Multitask allocation in smart camera network is assigned in such a way that results in the reduction of energy consumption without minute changes in the performance of the target tracing and representation. Algorithms that are assigned for each task must be effective and the weight is varied in accordance with the threshold values for energy resources. This paper represents, how a little change in the task allotment, algorithm and energy resources for smart camera results a major role in the grown of implementation of vision task and life time.

articleTitle: Wireless power transfer system using loop antenna and its gain enhancement using SRR metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: This project involves understanding wireless power transfer system using loop antennas and split ring resonators(SRR) metamaterial. The goal is design and development of loop antenna and SRR metamaterial with desired specifications. Gain enhancement by metamaterial is demonstrated between transmitting and receiving antennas.

articleTitle: A new implimentation of catheterization laboratory
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: A catheterization laboratory or Cath lab is room in a hospital equipped with facilities to visualize the diseased arteries and chambers of the heart. It's also a facility to treat any stenosis or abnormalities found. This is done by inserting a catheter in to the artery and injecting a dye or a contrast material into it. The work of the dye is to highlight the path flow of the blood and any obstacles on the way. Compared to other heart tests and treatment procedures this too carries increased risk due to the allergic reaction of contrast dye or the medicines administered. To overcome this risk factor X-ray images are taken to see how the dye moves through the artery. This X-ray video is then divided into frames to find the blockage in blood vessel. This proposed technique is done using MATLAB tool.

articleTitle: Performance of shunt active power filter controlled by constant power control technique
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Growing the use of nonlinear devices for purpose of the controlling the machines as per our definition. These circuits are based on power semiconductor switching devices which are for most of harmonic source in our network. Due to negative effect of harmonics, the filtration of it must require. The active power filter is most superior solution in eliminating unwanted harmonics. This paper will speak and discuss the simulation and its result for a 3-phase 3-wire shunt active power filter with the use of MATLAB/Simulink software. This simulation will implement a non-linear load and compensate line current harmonics under balanced 3-phase diode rectifier load and compare with case of balanced and unbalanced voltages. The constant power compensation control techniques based on p-q theory is being used for giving control of SAPF and try to reduce the total harmonic distortion (THD) that's required by way of quality requirements IEEE-519.

articleTitle: Designing prototype for accessing Veracity using social sensors - big data perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Social sensing is firmly taking its stand as the most efficient and surplus journalistic tool. It involves the gathering and verification of news data from Social media. Social media provides a wide range of real-time postings of events from around the globe. Social sensing works out certain executions to process the collected UGC and eradicate fake and falsehoods. Thus assorted data content is implemented with TDT (Topic - Detection and Tracking) to find topic oriented material and the selected content is checked for falsehood with Veracity Analyzers. In the end the processed UGC is eligible to be published as valid news data by journalist.

articleTitle: Design of highly directional CPW-FED UWB antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: In this paper a new antenna design using coplanar waveguide (CPW) suitable for Ultra Wide band (UWB) communication. It consists of two ground planes etched on the both side of the radiator. A ground plane having the slot structure. i.e. partial ground. By using a circle shaped radiator with rectangular cut provides much impedance bandwidth. This antenna has a better return loss less than -10 dB for operating frequency of 7 GHz. The S11 and VSWR are simulated using HFSS.

articleTitle: Pattern recognition based fault classification for teed transmission line
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Transmission line protection schemes of teed lines poses difficulties due to infeed or out feed from teed terminal. Reflections from Third Terminal Point also complicate the protection aspect. In this paper, a protection scheme for fault classification using Wavelet transform based power spectrum density is presented for teed transmission line. The spectrum based fault density analysis uses Wavelet transform to extract the usable frequency bands to be used to enhance fault patterns of various fault signal for faulty phase identification. The scheme uses high frequency components of the fault current signals for fault classification. Autoregressive power spectrum density estimate by Yule-walker method is used for distribution of power which is term of frequency.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of three leg DSTATCOM under distributed generation and fault scenario
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: In modern power distribution system, use of nonlinear loads has increased drastically. Due to these nonlinear loads, power quality of the system is decreasing. Hence there is necessity of improving power quality of the system. Distribution Static Compensator (DSTATCOM) is a shunt connected custom power device, used in distribution system for performance improvement. DSTATCOM will maintain constant voltage at load terminals and maintains the shape of current and voltage by reducing the distortions. This paper presents a case study on investigation of performance of DSTATCOM at different operating scenarios. IEEE 13 bus industrial system is used to study the performance of three leg DSTATCOM. Voltage control mode with PI control is used to control RMS voltage at point of common coupling (PCC).

articleTitle: Modified integration method to estimate stator flux in induction motor with offset error
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: This paper present the new technique of calculating the stator flux. The method comprise of new integrator technique by virtue of which the errors which occurs in case of pure integrator can be eliminate. The pure integrator which is already present in the conventional direct torque control method (DTC) have several bugs which can be eliminate by this new integrator design. Offset error occur in conventional DTFC method which caused undesirable variations. By this new method offset can reduce. By observing the flux the offset can be maintained. For that purpose generally flux observers can use in the form of PI controller. The DTFC design presented here includes the proportional integrator derivative (PID) block. Proportional controller can also be used as the flux observer. Because of the simplicity of the design the low pass filter (LPF) and high pass filter (HPF) can also be include to modify traditional integrator to eliminate bugs.

articleTitle: Analysis and modeling of thermal plant pollution performance in high tension ceramic post insulator with Epoxy Resin coatings
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: The insulator is the major constituents in any electrical transmission and distribution system. Pollution is one of the most significant phenomena, which determine the performance of the insulator and also dissembles the entire electrical power systems. The pollution performance is a diplomatic problem with worldwide, which depend upon the climatic condition. The purpose of high voltage insulator is to withstand electrical stress due to high electric field intensity. A new swing antipollution coating is enforced to improve the flashover voltage. In this work, pollution performance test acquired to the 11kV post type ceramic insulator polluted by the coastal thermal power plant without coating and with Epoxy Resin coating. The experiments have been carried out in both categories (without and with coating) adopt in IEC standard. In simulation modeling, FOV (Flash over voltage) and NSDD (Non-soluble deposit density) are predicted and then compared with computational real value through Artificial neural network in simulation software packages.

articleTitle: High fitness population (HFP) with GA solution for solving unit commitment of large system
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: For larger system, solution space increases exponentially with the number of time periods and units in the system, therefore the computation time becomes impractical. This paper presents an improved two layer approach for solution for large systems. The first layer generate constraints satisfied high fitness population (HFP) and the second layer is incorporated with a GA algorithm for solving the UC problem. Near global point, limited option is left for minimization work, so to direct the limited option in HFP better way, easy method is proposed to handle GA mutation. To verify the performance of the proposed algorithm, it is applied to large system up to 40-100 units in one-day scheduling period. The power of proposed algorithm is that a solution near to global solution is available at start and execution time remains in seconds range for large system. Results presented in this paper demonstrate the superiority of proposed algorithm solution in terms of solution quality, faster convergence and no of iterations with other conventional methods/computing techniques.

articleTitle: Designing software reuse repository through intelligent classification for effective search and retrieval mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Reuse of software component benefits in the growth of new applications by using the already accessible components. Reusable components can be used in most essential and effective way for the improvement of productivity and quality of software projects. To reuse components from the repository, we have to focus on selecting the appropriate retrieval process. The Choice of selecting the finest or best fit component and excellent possible selection of the Component which we have retrieved is trickier than simple retrieval of the component. More improvement done on software reuse initiatives to find the reusable components in an effectual way. However, searching and retrieval of such information from the repository is a major concern in literature, once there is a space present between what is stored in the repository and what the s/w engineer is willing to retrieve. In this paper, first we are classifying the components and second we are implementing operational Semantic based approaches and Genetic algorithm based approach for search and retrieval of the components.

articleTitle: Matching of video frames through coupled decomposition
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: In this paper an algorithm used for video matching process is discussed. This algorithm basically works on the principle of tie-point extraction. This algorithm is conceptualized to extract information from different video frames in the similar locations. This extracted information is called tie-points. Without the video matching process, most of the video processing applications cannot exist. A few applications where video matching plays a vital role is video retrieval, video registration and 3D construction. In the current methodologies, full frame matching is done, where an important parameter called spatial constraint is being neglected. The spatial constraint will give the information about the area from where the tie-points are being extracted, which is in fact going to lead the matching process. The matching of video frames through coupled decomposition is a novel technique which is introduced in this paper. This algorithm will also include the spatial constraints in the matching process along with the parameters used in the general methodologies. Though in this technique the sub frames are generated from the reference and target frames as the subsamples of conventional methods, in the generated sub frames, some specific characteristics like geometric transformation, additive noise and global radiometric differences remain consistent. They remain robust to the local changes.

articleTitle: GAMES-glaucoma analysis and management using an expert system
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: As of late, Computer-rooted methods are progressively used to revamp the quality of medical domain services. There are a various PC pull techniques that are utilized for the finding of eye maladies, for example, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, and cataract and so on. However, these system are independent programming with basic usefulness. An expert system (ES) for the diagnosis of glaucoma disease is proposed which uses databases of medical knowledge to offer advice or make decisions. The GAMES is composed of knowledge base, user interface and inference engine. The proposed medicinal GAMES is utilized to analyze the glaucoma illness among the patients. The diagnosis is done taking into account the symptoms which can be felt or seen. The proposed GAMES will be genuinely useful to the patients to secure the mandatory advice about the glaucoma malady and can also ease the work of expert or doctor in putting together the proper or suitable diagnosis of patient.

articleTitle: A leading zero(es) count algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Floating point operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division for normalization require removing the leading zeros. Algorithms to remove the leading zeroes using NOR logic for input bits along with carry, XOR logic on result of floating point operation are proposed in literature. This paper proposes leading zero count algorithm using NAND logic for adjacent bits of result of floating point operation for normalization. The proposed method is simulated for floating point addition algorithm using one's complement notation for add/subtract operation with Quartus2 software Cyclone II family processor. An improvement in area by 43%, with increased performance of 52% with no change in power consumption is observed when compared with two's complement addition operation using XOR operation for counting leading zeroes.

articleTitle: Solar Photovoltaic array based multilevel inverter for power conditioning in four-wire distribution system
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: This paper proposes a photovoltaic (PV) array based cascaded H-bridge multilevel inverter (CHBMLI) working active power filter as a shunt for four wire distribution system. This system is used for the power acclimatizing of distribution network as it is composed of linear, nonlinear and unbalanced loads. Solar Photovoltaic formed isolated source for CHBMLI. This active filter minimize line harmonics, minimize neutral wire current about to zero and it also injects real power as per requirement of the system. The grid interface and required reference signal generation is carried out with the help of Instantaneous power theory. The simulation studies are carried out in MATLAB Simulink environment.

articleTitle: A perceptive based application along with high frequency direction finder during quagmire in our provincial
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: We propose a system in which it allows the user to contact or make an alert during any emergency situation to the appropriate service provider directly using this application. Though there are several apps in the market, what makes our application special is that it is completely in our Tamil language. Here the user has to download and install the application along with all the required details. In case of any emergency situation, the user can just make an alert or call the service provider directly from the application. While making an alert or call, the global position using the latitude and longitudinal coordinates of the user will also be sent to the service provider. All the information about the service provider will be stored pre-definably in the application and it can also be updated or new contacts can be added if required. In this application, we did not use any tool for translating the text into our Tamil language. We are using the BAMINI as a font and is imported for the user interface of the application. The main drawback is to overcome the language complexity. It is in our Tamil language which makes it to be used even by people who doesn't know any foreign language hence making it more user-friendly.

articleTitle: Graphene photovoltaic panel (GPP)
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: The principle objective of this paper is to demonstrate the increased efficiency of graphene photo-voltaic panel for the application of self illuminating light bulb, also to overcome the problems regarding portability, implementation and cost using emerging material graphene. Graphene material is 2D allotrope of carbon with extraordinary quality like high electrical and heat conductivity with better physical parameters. It can be the best solution to illuminate the dense populated area as it generates high power in less area and within less time. It can generate the power from light, rain water and salt water too. It makes this panel, the best modification in series of photo-voltaic panels. So GPP have potential to create new era.

articleTitle: Design and development of Fuel Cell Oxygen Tree (FCOT)
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: A Fuel Cell Oxygen Tree is a combination of Artificial Oxygen Tree (AOT) and Fuel Cell (FC). AOT is use to obtain Hydrogen (for fuel) and Oxygen (to be emitted in the air) by performing sea water electrolysis; with the help of PV (Photovoltaic) panels to generate electricity from solar energy installed on the top of the trees. FC is a device which perform reverse electrolysis by using hydrogen as fuel for generating electricity and clean water. It is a process in which dc power supply is connected to the two electrodes making them anode and cathode which are placed in the sea water, H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas will get evolved at cathode and anode respectively by passing a current to the electrodes which are placed in sea water. The Hydrogen storage can be done in a tank and can used as a fuel for FC and oxygen will be left out for breathing in the air. The PV panel on the top of the tree will collect energy from the sun and convert it into electricity; which is a conventional source of energy. The main fuel which is sea water used in AOT is a renewable source of energy and in abundant on earth. Thus, this device completely operates on renewable energy.

articleTitle: Nano particle based drug delivery systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Drug delivery is the methods, creations, technologies, and schemes for carrying a pharmaceutical compound in the body as required to safely bring in its anticipated therapeutic effect. This paper mainly focuses in drug delivery system on efficient delivery of the particular drug to the concerned body part through any particular medium which can be directed by a chemical or physiological trigger.

articleTitle: Application and performance comparison of variants of the firefly algorithm to the Economic Load Dispatch problem
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: The Economic Load Dispatch problem is an optimization problem which minimizes cost such that the load demand is met and the generating equality and inequality constraints are satisfied. Previously, conventional techniques like linear programming and lambda iteration were applied to solve the economic dispatch problem given their simplicity. Nevertheless, they do not always converge to global optimum which gave rise to metaheuristic techniques such as evolutionary and bio-inspired swarm algorithms. Firefly algorithm is a swarm based recent metaheuristic that has a high convergence rate and short execution time compared to other metaheuristic techniques when solving the economic load dispatch problem. Given that the firefly algorithm has its shortcoming of getting trapped in local optima, many researchers have proposed modifications and hybrids that improve the performance of firefly algorithm to obtain optimum global solutions rapidly and efficiently. In this paper, three of these recent enhancements were adopted to solve the economic dispatch problem of six generating units. The performance of these variants was compared and analyzed. The results show high efficiency in achieving optimal results in less time than the original firefly algorithm.

articleTitle: Effects of demand side management & storage on renewable energy penetration to the grid
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: Recent developments in power electronic technology and government policies, lead to substantial increase in renewable penetration into the grid, especially from solar. Utility company usually incentivizes renewable energy schemes through Feed in Tariff or Net Metering mechanisms. This article presents a study on variation in renewable energy penetrated into distribution system under Net Metering mechanism and Feed in Tariff. The solar PV owner may try to increase the earnings from renewable energy installation and thereby reduce the pay-back time, with the help of demand side management (DSM) techniques and storage. Hence the energy penetrated in to the grid depends not only on the amount of generation, but also DSM and storage. The study is supported with a case study conducted for distribution feeder system with solar PV installation under different scenarios and results validate the requirement of such study. Also, the amount of penetrated power in percentage is tabulated which shows certain scenarios are worth to implement since it benefits both the utility and the micro grid.

articleTitle: Four-bit full adder-subtracter based on DNA strand displacement
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: DNA strand displacement is an emerging method in the field of biological computation in recent years. It is an enzyme-free technique, which does not require any other auxiliary materials in the process of the reaction. Strand displacement reaction performs computation based on the principle of complementary base pairing. We use strand displacement systems to generated large-scale reaction network, such as circuit, and chemical reaction network. We construct molecular logic computation modules based on DSD (DNA strand displacement), including AND logic and OR logic. The logic model is simulated by visual DSD, which can be used to perform logic computation. Using DSD, we design four-bit full adder-subtracter. The method proposed in this study can provide an effective way to construct logic gate, and be used to perform dual-rail logic circuit and SAT problem, which is a potential method to solve NP problems.

articleTitle: Technology options for DSM in interior lighting
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to educate the reader on the criteria to appraise overall energy efficiency of lighting systems and to provide guidelines for identifying energy saving options in lighting. The scope of this paper is limited to interior lighting installations like commercial buildings and industrial buildings. The methodology described in this paper helps to understand energy efficiency as referred to light sources, interior lighting design and performance assessment indicators. Luminous efficacy indicates energy efficiency of light sources, but it is not the parameter based on which quality of a lighting application is decided, for deciding quality, color rendering capability of a light source important and can be determined from its spectral properties. Hence its important to understand to assess a light source for its quality implications; this paper helps the user to do quality assessment of light sources. Lighting on the work plane in an interior depends on optical efficiency of luminaires, room dimensions and their surface reflectance. The idea of energy efficient lighting design is to provide highest luminous efficacy on the work plane by making use of efficient luminaire, room reflectance, mounting height and least lighting power consumption. Illuminating non-task areas is as critical as task areas so that there is enough luminance distribution in the background to aid in eye adaptation, safety and circulation. A energy efficient lighting interior is the best technology option for demand side management, thereby end user is encouraged to adopt way means reducing energy costs and improving lighting quality.

articleTitle: Active learning framework of informative p53 cancer rescue mutants
publicationTitle: 2017 Third International Conference on Advances in Electrical, Electronics, Information, Communication and Bio-Informatics (AEEICB)
abstract: P53 mutants are closely related to humor tumors. Unfortunately, in vitro testing of all possible mutation combinations to determine their cancer rescue effects is infeasible due to time and expense. Therefore, it would be very desirable to have a computer model to run in silico experiments. In this paper, we propose a framework for active learning that can be used in any membership model active learning which does not consider predicted class as a criterion. Because the number of positive instances is much more than the number of negative instances. An active learning strategy is proposed to dynamically balance the number of positive and negative instances. As a result, we get a relatively balanced training set relative to both positive and negative instances, which leads to results showing good performance relative to high precision as well as high recall.
